If the return value of the function call is other than E_OK this parameter does not contain valid data. -128dec...127dec PASSED...FAILED according to ISO 14229-1 Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: request was successful E_NOT_OK: request failed Description Gets the current fault detection counter value. There is one c-callback per event using monitor-internal debouncing, if no port interface is provided by the Dem. Available via Dem_Externals.h
